0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) host the Denver Nuggets (1-2, having lost their most recent game) in the Pelicans' fourth game of the season, with New Orleans 5th in the Southwest and 14th in the West. Yves Missi is out for the Pelicans with a knee bruise, while Denver is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams last met in Denver on October 24, when the Pelicans lost 141-135, and the 2026-27 season series has New Orleans trailing 0-1 after the Pelicans lost 0-3 to Denver in 2025-26.
